[size=3]25.05.26
1. Fix some texture errors.
2. Correct texture misalignment during bathing.
3. Change the structure of configuration options to make them less verbose and avoid SMAPI errors caused by incorrect selection of options.

24.11.19
1. Four new configuration options have been added：

fitted hair
fitted pants
fitted Female shirts
fitted Male shirts

allowing users to choose to use original tops and bottoms that fit their body shape, as well as hairstyles.

2. Add a configuration option：

soft skincolors

to choose from 12 softer skin tones.

3. Correct the texture of the mannequin model, and now it can display normally.

At this point, all basic content of this module has been updated. Thank you for your long-term support>U<!

24.11.01
Fix some pixel errors.
Modify the back of the body to align it with other directions.
Added the "F-showhead/M-showhead" configuration option, now you can freely choose whether to display the head.
Add a 'Transparent' style for "F-body/M-body", which will no longer display when selected.

[b][color=#ff7700]This update is mainly to support my high-definition clothing and accessories in the future, which can be updated according to your needs.[/color][/b]


24.07.28
Rewrite the structure of the file to make it easier to personalize and add new content in the future.

24.03.20[/size]
[size=3]This module is now adapted to version 1.6 and has made the following changes:
1. Added additional arm frames from version 1.6
2. Added an optional file created for the mannequin in version 1.6.
3. Fixed the order of arms when running on the side of the body, making the animation look more coherent.
4. Fixed some missing pixels
5. The head of the male body frame has been modified to fit more hairstyles without revealing from below.
[/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Please do not directly overwrite the old file!!![/b]

[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Need
[/b][/size][/color][size=3] SAMPI、ContentPather、Generic Mod Config Menu([/size]recommended[size=3])

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Install
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]1. Download and install all necessary. 
2. Download and unzip the file.
3. Put the extracted folder into "Mods"[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Because both the farmer body and the pants come with a bathrobe texture, usually the two bathrobe textures are the same, so when player change into a bathrobe, the two bathrobe textures will overlap without any problems. 

[/b][/size][/color][size=4][b][color=#ff7700]However, my mod removed the bathrobe texture from the farmer body (only in this way can the bathrobe style become selectable), and added some new styles. [/color][/b][color=#ff7700][b]In addition, most clothing mods (including the original version) have their own bathrobe texture for the pants.

So when player change into a bathrobe, their bathrobe texture will cover my bathrobe. The only solution is to delete the bathrobe texture from the pants texture in all downloaded clothing mods.[/b]
[/color][/size]


[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Important[/b]
[/size][/color][size=3]1.Because the body is changed from the original, most of the previous hairstyles, clothes and accessories are[color=#ff7700] not  applicable[/color].Supporting items for this body type（like clothes, hairstyles,and so on ） are [color=#ff7700]not suitable for other bodies[/color].
2. If you want to use other bodies, you can delete these folders from "Mods" .[/size]
[size=3]3. You can edit this mod[color=#ff7700] for your own use[/color]. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.
4. Please [color=#ff7700]do not spend money [/color]on modules published by [color=#ff7700]non authors[/color] for any reason.[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]因为人模跟下装都带有浴衣贴图，通常情况下两个浴衣贴图是一样的所以当换上浴衣后两个浴衣贴图就会重叠而不会有问题，但我的mod把原来在人模上的浴衣贴图删了（只有这样才能让浴衣款式变成可以选择的），同时增加了一些新的款式，此外绝大部分衣服mod（包括原版）的下装都是自带浴衣贴图的，所以当换上浴衣后它们的浴衣贴图就会覆盖到我的浴衣上面，解决方法只有自己把下载的所有衣服mod里下装贴图上的浴衣贴图给删了。
[/b][/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]
重要[/b][/size][/color]
1.[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]因为在原版的基础上改动较大，所以这个人模[/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=3]不适用绝大多数[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]其他作者的头发，衣服，帽子等等，这个人模的配套物品也[/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=3]不适用于其他人模[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]。[/size][/color][size=3]
[/size][size=3]2.不想再使用这个人模。可以[color=#ff7700]直接移除文件夹[/color][/size]。[size=3]
[color=#f4f4f4]3.除了[/color][color=#ff7700]自己私下使用[/color][color=#f4f4f4]，用于[/color][color=#ff7700]其他用途的修改和上传[/color][color=#f4f4f4]需要[/color][color=#ff7700]我的授权[/color][color=#f4f4f4]。[/color][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]4.[color=#f4f4f4]不要倒卖，不要付费去购买[/color][color=#ff7700]非作者发布且无授权[/color][color=#f4f4f4]的文件。[/color][/size][color=#00ffff][b]
